scientific_object.name: process-provenance-conditioned marginal memory utility
scientific_object.question: After conditioning on actionable memory content and target context, does process provenance contain additional information about downstream marginal utility, through which observable channel can that information affect behavior, and when is it worth using for memory governance?
non_claims: failure-derived memory is inherently low quality
a backend-only relabel can affect an executor that cannot observe it
the existing L1 writer-mode contrasts identify a provenance-only effect
PSMG has already improved downstream performance

identification_ladder.L1: outcome-conditioned writer-mode bundle under fixed target state; content and register can still change
identification_ladder.L2: byte-identical actionable memory with an explicit provenance-channel intervention; an unobserved backend-only relabel is an equivalence negative control
identification_ladder.L3: source-faithful transport on a fresh provenance-bearing substrate

mechanism_laws.statement: If neither executor nor governor can observe or use provenance, changing only an unobserved provenance label must not change the behavior distribution; any difference points to an uncontrolled channel or state mismatch.

If marginal utility is conditionally independent of provenance given content and target context, provenance has no incremental decision value and the optimal policy collapses to content-only governance.

Provenance matters operationally only when it changes the posterior over marginal utility enough to change an optimal reuse, verification, raw-trace escalation, abstention, or content-only fallback decision.

psmg.name: Provenance-Sensitive Memory Governance
psmg.role: prospective governance design, not a completed performance claim
stages: CAPTURE: keep actionable content separate from immutable trajectory/evaluator/extractor/transformation lineage
ESTIMATE: estimate context-conditioned marginal utility with provenance as a shrinkable feature rather than a fixed outcome-quality label
DECIDE: choose reuse, cautious reuse, verify-then-reuse, raw-trace escalation, abstention, or content-only fallback from expected utility, downside risk, and verification cost
UPDATE: update contribution estimates only from frozen randomized inclusion/withholding, fixed-context replay, or explicitly modeled bundle interactions
SAFE_COLLAPSE: shrink provenance influence to zero when support, label reliability, information gain, or transport evidence is inadequate

E0_measurement_qualification: provenance-chain integrity through extraction, merge, split, summary, deduplication, and retrieval
utilization first stage with true, null, reversed, and shuffled memory
E1_association_to_causal_utility: separate observed reward/association from randomized or replay-estimated marginal utility
measure negative-utility success-associated memories and useful failure-derived memories
report rank and calibration gaps between observational utility and marginal contribution
E2_channel_factorial: A1 matched content with no visible provenance

metrics: false promotion of negative-utility success memories
token, latency, call, and storage cost

experiment_program.E5_fresh_replication: Historical R4/R6 and L2 support-stop evidence remain frozen context only and are never pooled into the fresh confirmatory analysis.

fresh_substrate_gate: G1 source outcome provenance comes from an independent environment or evaluator rather than researcher post-labeling
G2 actionable content can be matched or canonicalized without consulting confirmatory target outcomes
G3 the intended intervention changes only the declared provenance channel; backend-only relabel is reserved as a negative control
G4 fresh target tasks are disjoint from historical R19 and the remaining legacy 27 units
G5 frozen terminal or decisive-action endpoints are replayable under the same evaluator
G6 independent task, template, or family defines statistical n; seeds and requests are nested repetitions
G7 matching, exclusion, and support decisions are outcome-blind with respect to confirmatory targets
G8 manifest, estimands, exclusions, moderators, precision or power rule, and stopping rule are frozen before first confirmatory outcome

historical_evidence_boundary.L0: strong source-bound association remains motivation only
historical_evidence_boundary.L1: writer-mode endpoints remain finite and directionally inconsistent; no provenance-only sign
historical_evidence_boundary.L2: historical exact-information design remains support-stopped at 5/10 with zero calls; this is not a null
historical_evidence_boundary.R19: archived; do not revive to increase experiment count
historical_evidence_boundary.legacy_27: non-confirmatory; do not mine for favorable support

reopen_condition: Authorize a fresh confirmatory run only after a provenance-bearing substrate passes G1-G8 and the exact channel, content-equivalence contract, utilization first stage, independent inference units, and PSMG evaluation plan are frozen before outcome inspection.
